reviews.text:
I want to thank Dr. Hoffer from the bottom of my heart for being with my beloved cat until his very last breath. Thank you for your kindness and gentleness. You helped me immensely through this difficult time.

Thank you for giving me the time to say goodbye.

Thank you for the kindness and understanding of the staff who listened to my grief, and for their availability and prompt care.

And thank you for all these years of caring for my cat.

I thank the entire team who mobilized to save my cat. The professionals were competent, but also kind and concerned about animal welfare. I highly recommend them. Special mention to the empathetic and reassuring welcome.

Thank you very much.
Super nice

My pet has been a patient at this clinic for almost 11 years and I don't regret my initial choice: clean premises, welcoming staff, attentive, compassionate, professional veterinarians who are dedicated to animal welfare. I highly recommend them!

I will never forget the professionalism of veterinarian Dr. Fidel, who treated my 17-year-old Clochette with gentleness and compassion.

From the moment she received the diagnosis until her last breath, as she suffered greatly, Dr. Fidel demonstrated profound sensitivity, but above all, unparalleled honesty and transparency.
It is never easy for a veterinarian to face a dying animal, and it is with this understanding that I wish to express my deepest gratitude to the Guillotière Veterinary Clinic, its veterinarian, and its veterinary assistant, Mr. Germain M. Richard, who was always so kind at reception and in whom I have complete confidence.

It's easy to get an appointment, even if there's a bit of a wait.
The staff is friendly and competent.
I recommend it. Especially since they have an on-site analysis lab (very convenient).

What else can I say... excellent welcome, incredibly professional staff. They took great care of our little companions and, most importantly, they took the time to look after Gribouille and Simba.
Thank you again to the whole team!
A very warm welcome at this veterinary clinic. Professional, attentive and friendly.

Dr. Hoffer provided an excellent diagnosis. My cat had a blade of grass stuck in its nose that no one had noticed, and she immediately suspected this. A procedure was scheduled for the following day, but after the consultation, my cat expelled the grass. The appointment was quick to schedule, and the consultation was truly thorough. I highly recommend this clinic!

Dr. Hoffer is our vet for our cats. She understands behavioral issues very well and gives excellent advice, as well as other health concerns. My beloved cat, Dr. Hoffer, took her time with the appointment but felt comfortable with her. She doesn't push unnecessary treatments and takes the time to explain everything during consultations. The reception staff is also very friendly and helpful. And they have reliable contacts for pet-sitting our furry friends (or dogs, most likely) while we're on vacation.

Dr. Cécile Hoffer is a veterinarian passionate about her work, who loves animals and dedicates countless hours to her practice. She has been treating my dog ​​since she was a puppy. Very conscientious and attentive, she has always been able to diagnose and treat her dogs accurately. She takes the time to explain things thoroughly and is available whenever needed.

Congratulations on your outstanding work. Thank you to you and your team.

I highly recommend her.
A small, friendly clinic with passionate veterinarians. The reception staff are lovely. I highly recommend it.
Our dog has been seen by the vets at this clinic since she was 3 months old. They always give excellent advice. I highly recommend them!

Dr. Pignet is truly wonderful; she inspires real confidence and takes excellent care of our cats.

However, the call handling is disastrous. It's impossible to get through to anyone during opening hours; they NEVER answer. I had two emergencies with my cat, and I could have just left her to choke on her own because no one ever answered (and yet I called about ten times). It's best not to have an emergency, otherwise you can manage on your own.

Brought my Dogue de Bordeaux here for a tapeworm treatment before heading back to the U.K. Everything about the process, from the online reservation to the reception and the doctor's consultation, was smooth, professional and caring. I'm so happy to chance upon this doctor(Cecile Hoffer) and her clinic. I can't recommend them enough!

Fantastic veterinary clinic!

I took my kitten there for his first vaccination, microchipping, and neutering, and I have absolutely no complaints. The follow-up care is excellent, the advice is great, and the neutering procedure was impeccable! I definitely plan to continue going to them :)

Regular monitoring of the animals with reminders for visits, attentive listening with excellent advice

and always with a smile.

I recommend this clinic a thousand times over. The veterinarians and assistants are deeply committed, caring, attentive, available, and responsive. My dog ​​has been a patient there for three years, and I chose to bring my cat there for his final days. It was the best decision I could have made. They were always available by email and phone right up to the very end, providing gentle and empathetic support.
Truly, a 100% positive experience.
Dr. Pignet is very competent, welcoming, and warm. She knows how to reassure our animals and is very kind. I highly recommend her!

Excellent veterinary clinic! The prices are reasonable!
The team took great care of my cat, who had to have surgery. They even trimmed his claws and bathed him (he's extremely lazy about grooming himself). Thank you all!
Hello, I'm Cécile. I wanted to share my very first experience at the veterinary clinic. I was able to get an appointment quickly, and the staff are kind and caring. I recommend them 100%!
The team is lovely 🥰 …

I had a wonderful first experience with my kitten thanks to Dr. Hoffer, who took the time to answer my many questions and gave me lots of valuable advice! Dr. Hoffer was very gentle, and my kitten felt incredibly comfortable, which was very reassuring for a first-time adoption. Thank you so much for your care! 🥰 …

With our three senior cats, all over 17 years old, we have been going to the Guillotière Veterinary Clinic, Dr. Hoffer, and her team for several years now.

We are very satisfied with their services and have had the opportunity to appreciate their empathy, dedication, and great respect for animals.
On several occasions, Dr. Hoffer has been able to grasp the urgency of situations, has been very responsive, and has demonstrated a high level of professionalism.

Dr. Hoffer and the other veterinarians and assistants are always excellent, reassuring, professional, and available.

After 12 years, Iasou is still delighted to walk through the clinic doors! 🐶

For the past five years, our elderly cat has been receiving regular care at the Guillotière veterinary clinic. After approximately fifteen to twenty visits during this time, we can confidently say that the entire team, from reception to the veterinarians, are truly professional, competent, and caring. Thank you to the whole team for their excellent service and responsiveness.

A warm welcome!

Dr. Hoffer is fantastic! Attentive, available, and very professional. I highly recommend him!

Dr. Hoffer was exceptional with our Marcel these past few years, including when it came time to say goodbye.

She demonstrated outstanding professionalism and empathy, always putting our cat's well-being first. Thank you so much!

For over 20 years, I've entrusted my cats to Dr. Hoffer and his team. With each visit, I've experienced their exceptional professionalism and genuine concern for animal welfare. I recommend them wholeheartedly.

Trust, kindness, patience, and a love of animals.
Professionalism.
These are the qualities of our veterinarian and her assistant.
Very satisfied with Dr. Hoffer and the team in general, for almost 10 years.
Thank you so much for the kindness, professionalism, and attention the doctor gave to the abandoned kitten today. The little guy is very grateful. I highly recommend this professional.

I'm a regular patient at this clinic; the doctors and staff are competent and very attentive.
Highly recommended.

I'm delighted to have entrusted my cat to Dr. Hoffer and his assistants and colleagues for the second time! The team provides all the attention, security, and support we expect for our companions! My cat has been hospitalized twice at the Guillotière clinic, and it went very well. The instructions for caring for my cat at home are very clear, and the reception is very pleasant. I highly recommend them!
Top-notch clinic, excellent reception, and skilled staff

Excellent clinic! The staff were incredibly patient in welcoming us (we were rescuing feral kittens, so our appointment had to be rescheduled several times), and the veterinarian who treated them was very patient and gentle. Thank you to everyone for the warm welcome and the time they gave us! You can go there with complete confidence.

Excellent veterinary clinic, the best I've ever visited! Dr. Hoffer is very attentive, takes the time to make an accurate diagnosis, and always offers the most appropriate solutions. She also gives invaluable advice. The entire team is wonderful, welcoming, and professional. I highly recommend them!

UPDATE: I want to express how exceptional this veterinarian is, including in supporting clients through the most difficult decisions. She demonstrates great compassion, attentiveness, and respect, both for the animal and its owner. I am deeply grateful for everything. And of course, the day I get a new pet, I will return without hesitation.

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic, especially Dr. Pignet, I truly appreciated her humanity, attentiveness, empathy, integrity, intellectual honesty, and transparency. She took care of my life companion—with a sadly tragic outcome—but her gentle, discreet presence and the care she provided for my Oliver were impeccable. Dr. Pignet answered all of my questions, gave me sincere and transparent perspectives, speaking French slowly so I could understand, as I don't speak the language very well. She also gave me all the time I needed, going well beyond office hours, to say goodbye and accompany my greatest love on his final journey. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Competent and friendly team
Excellent service. The vet was very attentive and provided good advice regarding both the animal and its environment.
I've been taking my cat Cléo to Cécile Hoffer for 15 years, and it's always gone very well despite my cat's bad temper; the vet has always known how to handle it.
Very competent!

My cat has been a patient at this clinic for four years. I've always had excellent experiences; the vets are always very patient, attentive, and offer great advice, as well as being very gentle with the animals.

I highly recommend them.
Excellent clinic, very kind and efficient! My dog ​​had emergency surgery and it went very well, thank you!

I'm very satisfied with this clinic. Dr. Pignet has been treating my puppy since he arrived. She was very available, patient, and immediately made the correct diagnosis (giardiasis) and gave excellent advice.

In addition, the clinic contacted me several times during treatment to make sure everything was going well; there's real follow-up. The receptionists are also very pleasant.
I highly recommend them!
Excellent experience, I highly recommend it

A very positive experience with the initial care for my cat: vaccinations, spaying, microchipping, everything went very well! The vets are very kind and offer excellent advice. I'm so glad I went to this clinic.

A very positive experience at this veterinary clinic. The woman was incredibly kind and did everything to make my cat comfortable—she wasn't even stressed! I was guided every step of the way right up to saying goodbye, and everything was explained clearly, even before I had a chance to ask questions. Truly reassuring and professional.
We went there for spaying, vaccinations, and stitch removal.

The visits always go well; the vets give excellent advice and provide thorough follow-up after each visit.

And the prices are reasonable! Which isn't always the case in Lyon.

My French bulldog, Oggy, has been a vet here for almost six years.

A fantastic team, excellent care, clear and precise explanations, whatever the reason for the visit. What more could you ask for?

Thank you to the whole team for this flawless service, Oggy loves you all! 🫶🏻
Excellent service, very calm and attentive

If you're looking for a safe place for your four-legged companions, don't hesitate to visit the Guillotière veterinary clinic.
My animals have been treated there for years, and I wouldn't change it for the world.

Excellent veterinary clinic. Dr. Hoffer is wonderful and very available. My cat, who recently suffered from kidney failure, has made a full recovery, with his blood tests returning to normal within six months. She explains things clearly, is patient and reassuring, takes her time, and has been caring for my Bambi for 16 years with great gentleness and love. A big thank you to you and your entire team, Doctor.

Antonella Madignier.
The best clinic in Lyon and the surrounding area. Serious, professional, pleasant... I can trust you completely.

Excellent vet and attentive team/professionalism and quality of service/attentive to the animal, its suffering, and its needs, leaving the owner reassured/great advice and regular follow-up/pure kindness and compassionate care, in short, I highly recommend them
Excellent clinic with very busy vets and a great reception

The staff were very pleasant, helpful, understanding, and gentle with the animals.

I especially thank Dr. Pignet for his excellent care of my cats.

I highly recommend them.

I don't usually leave reviews, but I wanted to thank the whole team who are so attentive, warm, and professional. My little cat was scared when they removed her bandage and stitches after her spaying, but the vet and one of the assistants …
